activity_summary: In the parlour after the cry, you had the horses and the flour, and Richard had the gallery. The lawyers went quiet. He had that from the stage. Kemp said you were more fearful a fortnight ago, with the cold. Sincler asked how a man stands so as to look dead. You told him to think of the reckoning. The Rose has the second Tamburlaine. You did not go, and you did not see the yard from under the stage.
